name: Do I need to waterproof my bathroom floor before tiling?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to waterproof my bathroom floor before tiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proper waterproofing of your bathroom floor, especially in shower areas, is crucial before tiling. This essential step prevents water from seeping through the grout lines and tile backer board into the subfloor and wall cavities. Without adequate waterproofing, moisture can lead to structural damage, wood rot, mold growth, and costly repairs. We utilize industry-standard waterproofing membranes and techniques to ensure a durable and long-lasting installation that protects your home from water damage.
